```{r}
data <- updated

# Calculate totals for each row across columns AO to AU
data$Total_Yes <- rowSums(data[, c("Chinese", "English", "Dutch", "Math", 
                                  "Science", "History", "Geography")] == "Yes", 
                         na.rm = TRUE)

data$Total_No <- rowSums(data[, c("Chinese", "English", "Dutch", "Math", 
                                 "Science", "History", "Geography")] == "No", 
                        na.rm = TRUE)

data$Total_NA <- rowSums(data[, c("Chinese", "English", "Dutch", "Math", 
                                 "Science", "History", "Geography")] == "NA", 
                        na.rm = TRUE)

# To verify the results
head(data[, c("Chinese", "English", "Dutch", "Math", "Science", "History", 
              "Geography", "Total_Yes", "Total_No", "Total_NA")])
```
```{r}
# Create binary_obj_under column
data$binary_obj_under <- ifelse(data$Total_Yes > 0, 2, 1)
# View the distribution of the new column
table(data$binary_obj_under, data$Total_Yes)
```

```{r}
# Create high_ability column
data$high_ability <- ifelse(rowSums(data[, c("gifted_mem", "tot", "extra_support", 
                                            "extra_support_past")] == 2) > 0, 2, 1)
```

```{r}
# Create a summary table to verify the coding
verification_table <- table(data$high_ability,
                          data[, c("gifted_mem", "tot", "extra_support", 
                                 "extra_support_past")])
print(verification_table)
```
```{r}
# Load the required library
library(writexl)

# Export the data to Excel
write_xlsx(data, "updated_analysis.xlsx")
```
```{r}
# Convert high_ability to factor with clear labels
data$high_ability <- factor(data$high_ability, 
                           levels = c(1, 2),
                           labels = c("No", "Yes"))

# Verify the conversion
table(data$high_ability)
```
```{r}
# Count the frequency of each value in binary_obj_under
table(data$binary_obj_under)
```

```{r}
# Perform t-test with the categorical variable
t_test_result <- t.test(SIPI_sum...53 ~ high_ability, data = data)
t_test_result
```
```{r}
# Linear regression
model <- lm(SIPI_sum...53 ~ high_ability, data = data)
summary(model)
```
```{r}
# One-way ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(SIPI_sum...53 ~ high_ability, data = data)
summary(anova_result)
```


```{r}
# Model 1: Subjective underachievement as moderator
model1 <- lm(SIPI_sum...53 ~ high_ability * sub_under, data = data)
summary(model1)

# Model 2: Objective underachievement as moderator
model2 <- lm(SIPI_sum...53 ~ high_ability * binary_obj_under, data = data)
summary(model2)
```
```{r}
# Load required library
library(ggplot2)

# Create an interaction plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(high_ability), y = SIPI_sum...53, color = factor(binary_obj_under))) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = factor(binary_obj_under))) +
  labs(title = "Interaction between High Ability and Objective Underachievement",
       x = "High Ability Status",
       y = "Daydreaming Score (SIPI)",
       color = "Objective Underachievement") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red"),
                    labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# Calculate mean daydreaming scores for each combination
aggregate(SIPI_sum...53 ~ high_ability + binary_obj_under, data = data, mean)
```

```{r}
# Create interaction plot for subjective underachievement
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(high_ability), y = SIPI_sum...53, color = factor(sub_under))) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = factor(sub_under))) +
  labs(title = "Interaction between High Ability and Subjective Underachievement",
       x = "High Ability Status",
       y = "Daydreaming Score (SIPI)",
       color = "Subjective Underachievement") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkgreen", "orange"),
                    labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
aggregate(SIPI_sum...53 ~ high_ability + sub_under, data = data, mean)

```

```{r}
# Create a box plot with added elements for better visualization
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(high_ability), y = SIPI_sum...53)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.1, color = "darkblue") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "red", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Daydreaming Scores by High Ability Status",
       x = "High Ability Status (1: No, 2: Yes)",
       y = "Daydreaming Score (SIPI)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# For objective underachievement as predictor
model_obj <- lm(SIPI_sum...53 ~ binary_obj_under * high_ability, data = data)
summary(model_obj)

# For subjective underachievement as predictor
model_subj <- lm(SIPI_sum...53 ~ sub_under * high_ability, data = data)
summary(model_subj)
```

```{r}
# Plot for objective underachievement
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(binary_obj_under), y = SIPI_sum...53, color = factor(high_ability))) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = factor(high_ability))) +

                    labels = c("No", "Yes")) +

# Plot for subjective underachievement
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(sub_under), y = SIPI_sum...53, color = factor(high_ability))) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = factor(high_ability))) +
  labs(title = "Effect of Subjective Underachievement on Daydreaming by High Ability Status",
       x = "Subjective Underachievement",
       y = "Daydreaming Score (SIPI)",
       color = "High Ability Status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red"),
                    labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Create a subset of only high-ability students
high_ability_data <- subset(data, high_ability == "Yes")
```

```{r}
high_ability_data
```


```{r}
# Analyze objective underachievement's effect on daydreaming for high-ability students
model_obj_high <- lm(SIPI_sum...53 ~ binary_obj_under, data = high_ability_data)
summary(model_obj_high)

# Analyze subjective underachievement's effect on daydreaming for high-ability students
model_subj_high <- lm(SIPI_sum...53 ~ sub_under, data = high_ability_data)
summary(model_subj_high)
```
